033    /**
034     * MSR and ASR use segment data for segment colors
035     * Assumes tg.H has been revised for clipping
036     * @param tg
037     * @param shapes 
038     */
039    private static void getMSRShapes(TGLight tg,
040            ArrayList<Shape2>shapes)
041    {
042        try
043        {
044            int linetype=tg.get_LineType();
045            if(linetype != TacticalLines.MSR && linetype != TacticalLines.ASR)
046                return;
047            
048            HashMap hmap=armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.getMSRSegmentColors(tg);
049            Shape2 shape=null;
050            
051            BasicStroke stroke=null;            
052            if(tg.get_Client().equalsIgnoreCase("ge"))            
053                stroke=armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.getLineStroke2(tg.get_LineThickness(),tg.get_LineStyle(),BasicStroke.CAP_ROUND,BasicStroke.JOIN_ROUND);                
054            else
055                stroke=armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.getLineStroke(tg.get_LineThickness(),tg.get_LineStyle(),BasicStroke.CAP_ROUND,BasicStroke.JOIN_ROUND);
056            
057            int j=0,n=tg.Pixels.size();
058            Color color=null;
059            Shape2 segShape=null;
060            shape=new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);
061            shape.setLineColor(tg.get_LineColor());
062            shape.setStroke(stroke);
063            
064            //if colors are not set then use one shape
065            //assumes colors may be set if string is comma delimited
066//            String strH=tg.get_H();
067//            if(strH != null && !strH.isEmpty())
068//            {               
069//                String[] strs=strH.split(",");
070//                if(strs.length<2)
071//                {
072//                    shape.moveTo(tg.Pixels.get(0));
073//                    //n=tg.Pixels.size();
074//                    //for(j=1;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
075//                    for(j=1;j<n;j++)
076//                    {
077//                        shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(j));
078//                    }
079//                    shapes.add(shape);
080//                    return;
081//                }
082//            }
083                        
084            //if the hashmap contains the segment then use the color corresponding to the segment
085            //in the hashtable to create a one segment shape to add to the shape array.
086            //else sdd the segment to the original shape
087            Color lastColor=null;   //diagnostic
088            double dist=0,dist2=0;
089            POINT2 pt0=null,pt1=null;
090            POINT2 lastPt=null;
091            //for(j=0;j<tg.Pixels.size()-1;j++)
092            for(j=0;j<n-1;j++)
093            {
094                pt0=tg.Pixels.get(j);
095                pt1=tg.Pixels.get(j+1);
096                if(hmap !=null && hmap.containsKey(j))
097                {
098                    color=(Color)hmap.get(j);
099                    if(color != lastColor)
100                    {
101                        if(segShape != null)
102                            shapes.add(segShape);                    
103                        
104                        segShape = new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_POLYLINE);                    
105                        segShape.setLineColor(color);
106                        segShape.set_Style(tg.get_LineStyle());
107                        segShape.setStroke(stroke);
108                    }
109                    segShape.moveTo(pt0);
110                    segShape.lineTo(pt1);                    
111                    lastColor=new Color(Integer.toHexString(color.toARGB()));
112               }                                    
113                else
114                {
115                    if(hmap !=null && hmap.containsKey(j+1))
116                    {
117                        shape.moveTo(pt0);
118                        shape.lineTo(pt1);
119                        lastPt=new POINT2(pt1);
120                    }
121                    else if(hmap !=null && hmap.containsKey(j-1))
122                    {
123                        shape.moveTo(pt0);
124                        shape.lineTo(pt1);                        
125                        lastPt=new POINT2(pt1);
126                    }
127                    else if(j==tg.Pixels.size()-2)
128                    {
129                        shape.moveTo(pt0);
130                        shape.lineTo(pt1);                                                
131                    }
132                    else
133                    {
134                        if(lastPt==null)
135                        {
136                            lastPt=new POINT2(pt0);
137                            shape.moveTo(lastPt);
138                            //shape.lineTo(lastPt);
139                        }                        
140                        dist=lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(pt0, pt1);
141                        if(dist>10)
142                        {
143                            //shape.moveTo(pt0);
144                            shape.lineTo(pt1);                                                
145                            lastPt=new POINT2(pt1);                            
146                        }
147                        else
148                        {
149                            dist2=lineutility.CalcDistanceDouble(lastPt, pt1);
150                            if(dist2>10)
151                            {
152                                //shape.moveTo(pt0);
153                                shape.lineTo(pt1);                                                
154                                lastPt=new POINT2(pt1);                            
155                            }                            
156                        }
157                    }
158                    //shapes.add(shape);
159                }
160            }
161            if(segShape != null)
162                shapes.add(segShape);                    
163            
164            shapes.add(shape);
165        }
166        catch (Exception exc)
167        {
168            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className ,"getMSRShapes",
169                new RendererException("Failed inside getMSRShapes", exc));
170        }
171    }
172    /**
173     * 
174     * @param tg
175     * @param converter client converter
176     * @param isTextFlipped
177     * @return
178     */
179    public static ArrayList<Shape2> GetLineArray(TGLight tg,
180            IPointConversion converter,
181            boolean isTextFlipped,
182            Object clipBounds)
183    {
184        ArrayList<Shape2> shapes=new ArrayList();
185        try
186        {
187            if(tg.Pixels==null || tg.Pixels.isEmpty())
188                return null;            
189            double x=0;
190            double y=0;
191            double width=0;
192            double height=0;
193            Rectangle2D clipBounds2=null;
194            int rev=tg.getSymbologyStandard();
195            
196            Rectangle2D clipRect=null;
197            ArrayList<Point2D>clipArray=null;
198            if(clipBounds != null)
199            {
200                if(clipBounds.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle2D.Double.class))
201                {            
202                    //clipRect=(Rectangle2D.Double)clipBounds;
203                    clipRect=(Rectangle2D)clipBounds;
204                    x=clipRect.getMinX()-50;
205                    y=clipRect.getMinY()-50;
206                    width=clipRect.getWidth()+100;
207                    height=clipRect.getHeight()+100;
208                    clipBounds2=new Rectangle2D.Double(x,y,width,height);
209                }
210                else if(clipBounds.getClass().isAssignableFrom(Rectangle.class))
211                {
212                    Rectangle rectx=(Rectangle)clipBounds;
213                    clipRect=new Rectangle2D.Double(rectx.x,rectx.y,rectx.width,rectx.height);
214                    x=clipRect.getMinX()-50;
215                    y=clipRect.getMinY()-50;
216                    width=clipRect.getWidth()+100;
217                    height=clipRect.getHeight()+100;
218                    clipBounds2=new Rectangle2D.Double(x,y,width,height);                    
219                }
220                else if(clipBounds.getClass().isAssignableFrom(ArrayList.class))
221                {
222                    clipArray=(ArrayList<Point2D>)clipBounds;
223                    clipBounds2=armyc2.c2sd.JavaRendererServer.RenderMultipoints.clsUtility.getMBR(clipArray);
224                }
225            }
226            
227            int lineType=tg.get_LineType();
228            int minPoints2=clsUtility.GetMinPoints(lineType);
229            ref<int[]> minPoints = new ref();
230            boolean bolResult = clsUtility.IsChange1Area(lineType, minPoints);
231            int bolMeTOC=armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsMETOC.IsWeather(tg.get_SymbolId());
232            
233            ArrayList<POINT2>pts=new ArrayList();
234            //uncomment one line for usas1314
235            Boolean usas1314=true;
236            int j=0,n=tg.Pixels.size();
237            switch(tg.get_LineType())
238            {
239                case TacticalLines.HOLD:
240                case TacticalLines.BRDGHD:
241                case TacticalLines.HOLD_GE:
242                case TacticalLines.BRDGHD_GE:
243                    if(tg.Pixels.size()<2)
244                        return null;
245                    if(usas1314)
246                        break;
247                    pts.add(tg.Pixels.get(0));
248                    //for(j=2;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
249                    for(j=2;j<n;j++)
250                    {
251                        pts.add(tg.Pixels.get(j));
252                    }
253                    pts.add(tg.Pixels.get(1));
254                    tg.Pixels=pts;
255                    break;
256                case TacticalLines.SINGLEC://reverse single concertina
257                case TacticalLines.SINGLEC2:
258                    pts=(ArrayList<POINT2>)tg.Pixels.clone();
259                    //for(j=0;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)
260                    for(j=0;j<n;j++)
261                        tg.Pixels.set(j, pts.get(pts.size()-j-1));
262                    break;
263                default:
264                    break;
265            }
266
267            //set CELineArray.shapes properties
268            BufferedImage bi=new BufferedImage(8,8,BufferedImage.TYPE_INT_ARGB);
269            Graphics2D g2d=bi.createGraphics();
270            
271            
272            Shape2 hatchShape=armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.getHatchShape(tg,bi);
273
274            if(tg.Pixels.size()<minPoints2)
275            {
276                bolResult=false;
277            }
278
279            if (bolResult)
280            {
281
282                tg.Pixels.clear();
283                bolResult = clsUtilityCPOF.Change1TacticalAreas(tg, lineType, converter, shapes);
284            }
285            else if(bolMeTOC>0)
286            {
287                if(tg.Pixels.size()<2)
288                    return null;
289
290                try
291                {
292                    clsMETOC.GetMeTOCShape(tg, shapes,rev);
293                }
294                catch(Exception exc)
295                {
296                    ErrorLogger.LogException(_className ,"GetLineArray",
297                        new RendererException("Failed inside GetLineArray", exc));
298                }
299            }
300            else
301            {
302                //this will help with click-drag mode
303                if(tg.Pixels.size()<2)
304                    if(lineType != TacticalLines.BS_CROSS)
305                        return null;
306                
307                if (CELineArray.CIsChannel(lineType) == 0)
308                {
309                    if(lineType==TacticalLines.ASR || lineType==TacticalLines.MSR)
310                    {
311                        getMSRShapes(tg,shapes);
312                    }
313                    else if(lineType !=TacticalLines.BELT1)
314                    {
315                        tg.Pixels=arraysupport.GetLineArray2(lineType, tg.Pixels,shapes, clipBounds2,rev, converter);
316                    }
317                    else if(lineType==TacticalLines.BELT1)
318                    {
319                        ArrayList<Shape2> tempShapes= null;
320                        ArrayList<P1>partitions=clsChannelUtility.GetPartitions2(tg);
321                        ArrayList<POINT2>pixels=null;
322                        int l=0,k=0,t=partitions.size();
323                        //for(l=0;l<partitions.size();l++)
324                        for(l=0;l<t;l++)
325                        {
326                            tempShapes= new ArrayList();
327                            pixels=new ArrayList();
328                            for(k=partitions.get(l).start;k<=partitions.get(l).end_Renamed+1;k++)
329                            {
330                                pixels.add(tg.Pixels.get(k));
331                            }
332                            pixels=arraysupport.GetLineArray2(lineType, pixels, tempShapes, clipBounds2,rev, converter);
333                            shapes.addAll(tempShapes);
334                        }
335                    }
336                }
337                else //channel type
338                {
339                    clsChannelUtility.DrawChannel(tg.Pixels, lineType, tg,shapes, null, clipBounds2, converter, rev);
340                }
341            }
342            //set CELineArray.shapes properties
343            if(bolMeTOC<=0)
344            {
345                if(lineType!=TacticalLines.ASR && lineType!=TacticalLines.MSR)                
346                    armyc2.c2sd.JavaTacticalRenderer.clsUtility.SetShapeProperties(tg,shapes,bi);
347                armyc2.c2sd.JavaRendererServer.RenderMultipoints.clsUtility.ResolveDummyShapes(tg, shapes);
348            }
349
350            if(hatchShape != null)
351                shapes.add(hatchShape);
352            //at this point tg.Pixels has the points from CELineArray
353            //the following line adds modifiers for those sybmols which require
354            //the calculated points to use for the modifiers.
355            //currentlly only BLOCK and CONTAIN use tg.Pixels for computing
356            //the modifiers after the call to GetLineArray
357            //Modifier2.AddModifiers2(tg);//flipped only for 3d for change 1 symbols
358            Modifier2.AddModifiers2RevD(tg, shapes);
359            Modifier2.addSectorModifiers(tg, converter);
360
361            //boundary has shapes for line break
362            Modifier2.GetIntegralTextShapes(tg, g2d, shapes);
363
364            bi.flush();
365            g2d.dispose();
366            bi=null;
367            g2d=null;
368        }
369        catch (Exception exc)
370        {
371            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className ,"GetLineArray",
372                new RendererException("Failed inside GetLineArray", exc));
373        }
374        return shapes;
375    }
376    /**
377     * Isolate and others require special handling for the fill shapes.
378     * @param tg 
379     * @param shapes the existing shapes which characterize the graphic
380     */
381    static protected void getAutoshapeFillShape(TGLight tg, ArrayList<Shape2>shapes)
382    {
383        try
384        {            
385            if(shapes==null || shapes.size()==0)
386                return;
387            if(tg.Pixels==null || tg.Pixels.size()==0)
388                return;
389            if(tg.get_FillColor()==null)
390                return;
391            
392            int linetype=tg.get_LineType();
393            int j=0;
394            Shape2 shape=new Shape2(Shape2.SHAPE_TYPE_FILL);
395            shape.setFillColor(tg.get_FillColor());
396            shape.setLineColor(null);
397            int t=shapes.size();
398            int n=tg.Pixels.size();
399            switch(linetype)
400            {
401                case TacticalLines.RETAIN:
402                    if(shapes!=null && !shapes.isEmpty())
403                        //for(j=0;j<shapes.size();j++)
404                        for(j=0;j<t;j++)
405                            shapes.get(j).setFillColor(null);
406                    
407                    shape.moveTo(tg.Pixels.get(0));
408                    for(j=1;j<26;j++)                    
409                        shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(j));
410                    
411                    shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(0));
412                    shapes.add(0,shape);
413                    break;
414                case TacticalLines.SECURE:
415                case TacticalLines.OCCUPY:
416                    if(shapes!=null && !shapes.isEmpty())
417                        //for(j=0;j<shapes.size();j++)
418                        for(j=0;j<t;j++)
419                            shapes.get(j).setFillColor(null);
420                    
421                    shape.moveTo(tg.Pixels.get(0));
422                    //for(j=1;j<tg.Pixels.size()-3;j++)                    
423                    for(j=1;j<n-3;j++)                    
424                        shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(j));
425                    
426                    shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(0));
427                    shapes.add(0,shape);
428                    break;
429                case TacticalLines.CONVOY:
430                case TacticalLines.HCONVOY:
431                    if(shapes!=null && !shapes.isEmpty())
432                        //for(j=0;j<shapes.size();j++)
433                        for(j=0;j<t;j++)
434                            shapes.get(j).setFillColor(null);
435                    
436                    shape.moveTo(tg.Pixels.get(0));
437                    //for(j=1;j<tg.Pixels.size();j++)                    
438                    for(j=1;j<n;j++)                    
439                        shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(j));
440                    
441                    shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(0));
442                    shapes.add(0,shape);
443                    break;
444                case TacticalLines.CORDONSEARCH:
445                case TacticalLines.CORDONKNOCK:
446                case TacticalLines.ISOLATE:
447                    //set the fillcolor to null for the existing shapes
448                    //we are going to create a new fill shape
449                    if(shapes!=null && !shapes.isEmpty())
450                        //for(j=0;j<shapes.size();j++)
451                        for(j=0;j<t;j++)
452                            shapes.get(j).setFillColor(null);
453                    
454                    shape.moveTo(tg.Pixels.get(0));
455                    for(j=26;j<47;j++)                    
456                        shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(j));
457                    
458                    shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(23));
459                    shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(24));
460                    shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(25));
461                    shape.lineTo(tg.Pixels.get(0));
462                    shapes.add(0,shape);
463                    break;
464                default:
465                    return;
466            }
467        }
468        catch (Exception exc)
469        {
470            ErrorLogger.LogException(_className ,"getAutoshapeFillShape",
471                new RendererException("Failed inside getAutoshapeFillShape", exc));
472        }
473    }
